# Test and diagnose

Use for SWE-bench software-repair tasks when identifying the test framework and planning a targeted reproduction.

1. Inspect the repository and reproduce the reported failure before changing production code.
2. Run `python /opt/rsi-skills/scripts/inspect_project.py --path <repository>`.
3. Prefer the smallest relevant test, then related regression tests.
4. Report observed failures and distinguish environment errors from product bugs.
5. Other references remain readable through Bash at `/opt/rsi-skills/references/`. The index at `/opt/rsi-skills/routing/index.yaml` lists them.

## Python ImportError recovery

When Python raises `ImportError` during pytest collection, preserve the package layout.

Check `sys.path`, the missing module name, and whether the test runner changed the working directory. Do not rewrite unrelated imports.

## pytest fixture scope

When a pytest fixture uses function scope, isolate mutable state from later tests.

Create the resource inside the fixture and close it in teardown. Do not store that resource on a session object.

## async function tests

When pytest runs a coroutine test, await the coroutine before asserting the result.

Mark the test with pytest-asyncio and close the event loop after the assertion. Do not call the coroutine without await.

## Git patch application

When git apply rejects a patch, run git apply --check before changing the source.

Compare the rejected hunk with the current file. Keep the patch limited to the reported lines and rerun the focused pytest.
